SUMMARY
>> DETACHED HOME WITH CONSERVATORY! Perfect for first-time buyers or downsizers. Boasting a spacious lounge, kitchen, bright conservatory overlooking the garden, enclosed front and rear gardens, and allocated parking.


DESCRIPTION
William H Brown are delighted to bring this attractive detached two-bedroom home to the market, offering well-presented accommodation throughout, a bright conservatory, enclosed gardens and the added benefit of allocated parking.

Ideal for first-time buyers, downsizers or those seeking a low-maintenance home, the property enjoys a welcoming and practical layout. The accommodation comprises an inviting lounge, a well-appointed kitchen and a spacious conservatory overlooking the rear garden, providing an excellent additional reception space for relaxing, dining or entertaining guests.

To the first floor, there are two well-proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom, offering comfortable and versatile living accommodation.

Externally, the property continues to impress. To the front, a fully enclosed garden is mainly laid to lawn and complemented by mature trees, creating an attractive first impression and a pleasant outdoor space. The enclosed rear garden has been designed with ease of maintenance in mind, featuring a lawned area, attractive planted borders and a timber garden shed, making it ideal for enjoying the outdoors throughout the year. The property also benefits from allocated parking conveniently located to the side.

Combining comfortable living spaces, appealing outdoor areas and a desirable detached design, this charming home represents an excellent opportunity for a range of buyers and early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all it has to offer.

Lounge 
Wood effect flooring,Double glazed window to the front aspect, Radiator, Stairs to the first floor

Conservatory 
Wood effect flooring, Radiator, Brickbase, Double glazed window surround, Double glazed French doors to the rear aspect

Bedroom One 
Wood effect flooring, Double glazed window to the front aspect, Fitted blinds, Radiator

Bedroom Two 
Wood effect flooring, Double glazed window to the rear aspect, Radiator

Bathroom 
Wood effect flooring, Frosted double glazed window to the side aspect, Low-level WC, Pedestal handwash basin, Panelled bath with shower overhead

Outside 
To the front of the property there is a fenced in garden, laid to lawn with mature trees. To the rear of the property there is an enclosed garden, laid to lawn with attractive planted borders and a wooden shed. There is also allocated parking to the side of the property.

description:
Immaculate Four-Bedroom Detached Home on the Barrett’s New Homes Development in Watton which benifits from seven years of NHBC.

Situated on the ever sought-after Barrett’s New Homes development in the heart of Watton, this exceptional four-bedroom detached home has been beautifully maintained by the current owners and is presented in truly immaculate, move-in-ready condition. Offering spacious, light-filled, and versatile accommodation throughout, this property is ideal for modern family living.

The property is accessed via a welcoming entrance hall, providing a bright and practical introduction to the home. From here, there is access to a useful cloakroom, a convenient coat cupboard, and a generous understairs storage cupboard, offering excellent everyday functionality.

The kitchen is positioned to the rear of the property and forms the heart of the home. It is comprehensively fitted with a range of contemporary base and wall-mounted units with worktops over, providing ample preparation and storage space. Integrated appliances include a gas hob, fitted oven, dishwasher, fridge, and freezer, alongside a handy laundry cupboard for additional convenience. Double doors open out onto the rear garden, flooding the space with natural light and creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living—perfect for entertaining or family life.

The lounge is located to the front of the property, offering a comfortable and stylish space to relax. A large window to the front aspect allows in plenty of natural light, while a fitted media plate provides a practical point for modern living.

Upstairs, the first-floor accommodation comprises three well-proportioned double bedrooms and one single bedroom, offering flexibility for families, guests, or home working. The principal bedroom benefits from its own ensuite shower room, finished to a modern standard. The remaining bedrooms are served by a contemporary family bathroom. Bedroom four is currently utilised as a dressing room, demonstrating the versatility of the space.

Externally, the property continues to impress. To the front, the garden is attractively stocked with a variety of flowers and shrub borders, enhancing the home's kerb appeal. The driveway provides tandem parking for multiple vehicles and leads to the garage. A side gate offers access to the rear garden, which is fully enclosed, providing a safe and private environment. The garden is predominantly laid to lawn, offering an ideal space for outdoor enjoyment.

Please note that an AML fee is chargeable to the buyer once an offer is accepted to cover the cost of carrying out the required identity and anti-money laundering checks. Once these checks have been completed, the fee cannot be refunded, even if the property purchase does not go ahead.

Watton boasts a range of traditional amenities including a post office, supermarkets, doctors surgery, chemist, infant, junior and secondary schools all within reach. There is a weekly town market, Watton Sports Centre offers a fitness suite, all weather courts, badminton, squash and snooker facilities while Richmond Park Golf Club has an 18-hole course, driving range and practice green.
